sources.facts: Former Birdsville Aboriginal Tracker’s Hut, Courthouse and Police Complex, register 600460. East court with a hipped end, side verandahs, sandstone, corrugated roof, timber-clad and later metal-clad residence and service areas.
2002 written government field survey QHP:003; attached residential section, dressed stone, corrugated iron and white coating. Other named precinct structures are separate.
2025 council technical assessment of the courthouse records sandstone, the south gable and chimney, sash openings, and evidence of white and pale blue limewash.
The current principal building survives as part of the reopened heritage precinct.
State Library of Queensland, native archived courthouse photograph made by William Patrick Boyle circa 1925.
